components.decision: DatePicker single/range consolidation advanced on 2026-08-30 against the ZIP DatePicker contract. DateRangePicker no longer owns duplicated calendar state/effects/cells/presets and delegates to DatePicker mode="range" as a compatibility surface. Keyboard coverage remains on the shared DatePicker implementation: ArrowLeft/Right move one day, ArrowUp/Down move one week, Home/End move to month edges, PageUp/PageDown move by month with day clamping, Shift+PageUp/Shift+PageDown jump by year, inline month/year selectors support keyboard selection, Tab cycles inside the panel, Escape and click outside close, and Enter/Space complete range selection. The runtime demos now keep month/year navigation on the selectors instead of reintroducing previous/next arrow buttons. The calendar ARIA contract was repaired to use a real grid/row/gridcell structure with button interaction inside cells, so axe no longer flags invalid role/aria combinations. Runtime demos now include canonical DatePicker range examples and DateRangePicker wrapper examples, both package-backed and starting closed.
